text:
Assistant A is more thorough and more accurate. It covers more of the key norms, including the 15-degree bow, using "-san" and waiting to be invited to use first names, and avoiding direct confrontation. Its dining advice is correct: wait to be seated, don't start until the host invites you to, leave a little food on your plate, and never pass food with chopsticks. Its note on odd-numbered gifts is also broadly accurate.

Assistant B is clear and well organized, and it adds two useful points A lacks: reading a business card before putting it away, and learning basic Japanese phrases. However, its dining advice to avoid leaving any food on your plate runs counter to Japanese custom, where leaving a small amount is considered polite. Its gift suggestion of chocolates is also generic. Overall, B is less detailed and contains one notable inaccuracy.

Neither response is badly flawed, but A offers more depth and fewer errors.

[[A]]
